stdout:
Global 4-Pad Mutation Tools - V1.34
  These commands now respect the validated four-lane system.

Performance lanes:
  Pad 1 = protected BD Hard kick foundation
  Pad 2 = secondary percussion / snare lane
  Pad 3 = SY Raw bass / synth-percussion motion lane
  Pad 4 = BD Acoustic body / accent pressure lane

Commands:
  X = balanced four-lane mutation
  D = deeper four-lane mutation
  I = intense / controlled chaos four-lane mutation
  4 = harder / wild discovery four-lane mutation
  Y = lane-aware SRC/morph mutation, choose depth
  V = lane-aware filter mutation, choose depth
  N = lane-aware grit mutation, choose depth
  Z = return all 4 pads to anchors

Behavior guardrails:
  X keeps Pad 1 stable and gives movement mostly to Pads 2-4.
  D pushes Pads 2-4 harder while protecting the kick foundation.
  I uses Pad 3 as the main chaos/motion carrier.
  4 is the wildest option but still keeps Pad 1 bounded.
  Y maps Pad 3 to morph instead of full raw SRC for more musical movement.
